prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: a production transparent sprite atlas for a hand-painted historical maritime RPG. Exactly 24 separate full body poses in strict 6 columns x 4 rows, landscape canvas 2304x1536, each cell 384x384, clear gutters. Each pose wholly within its cell, entire head, hands, feet, and sword tip visible. Consistent same adult person, costume, proportions, camera and scale, facing RIGHT with side-three-quarter view. No grid, labels, captions, floor, shadows, backgrounds or lettering. Truly transparent alpha background. Detailed realistic painterly game art, no chibi. Adult commanding dark shoulder-length-haired male admiral, navy and gold uniform with metal shoulder guards, gold medallion and belts, rich red gold-embroidered cape, tall boots. Preserve reference face and outfit. Wield one elegant naval saber. All 24 poses form four six-frame actions read left-to-right: row 1 overhead saber slash (ready, windup, high arc, downward cut, followthrough, recovery); row 2 horizontal thrust (guard, pull back, extend, full lunge, recoil, recovery); row 3 low sweeping cut (crouch windup, draw back, swing, extension, followthrough, recover); row 4 short pommel bash (guard, pull back, step in, pommel forward, followthrough, recover). Make limb and blade positions change clearly frame to frame. No motion trails. ANATOMY REQUIREMENT: show an unmistakable natural FIVE-digit sword grip. Four fingers fully curled around the cylindrical leather handle, thumb visibly opposing and crossing the index finger, handle enclosed INSIDE palm, continuous wrist-to-forearm connection. Blade guard in front of knuckles, pommel at little-finger side. Angle the wrist slightly to show the thumb as well as curled fingers, no fist merely resting above handle. No extra fingers, no straight dangling fingertips. All held objects must touch and be occluded by fingers.
